meta.name: Ashley Haden We All Die C ts
meta.description: Punchy, misanthropic and darkly humorous, Ashley's provocative material tackles all sorts of hot topics from Brexit, the Palestine/Israel Conflict, to privilege and austerity. With a philosophical humour that sticks two fingers up at the intelligentsia, Ashley is the self proclaimed "Genocidal Liberal" who embodies the working class wit breathing life back into an apathetic world.
